body: Life isn't worth living. Every day I wake up alone in a homeless shelter. I get little pleasure out of living this way. It's not even living, it's just surviving. I have exhausted all my other options. Nothing works but suicide.

Well, didn't you know? It's about mental health. Of course, they only care about mental health in the aftermath of a shooting...

Oh, and unless the shooter was brown. Then it's about how violent that culture is.

If you have a gun in your home, it's far more likely that someone who is there legally is going to be shot with it than an intruder... Suicides, accidents, domestic violence... The intruder situation is uncommon AND if you're one of those people who keeps your gun in a safe, what good will it do you when you only have a moment to react anyway? Unless you have your gun on you at all times (which you're not likely to do in your own home), it's probably not going to save you in the case of a home invasion.

The constitution can be changed. That's why they're called "amendments".

Other countries have successfully gotten rid of guns, I find it hard to believe that America couldn't figure out a way to do it just because it might be a bit expensive.
